en-US.description: Driverless hardware monitor and open telemetry server for Windows
en-US.longDescription: inFaux is a driverless, zero-install, zero-privilege hardware monitor and open telemetry server for Windows 10 & 11. It features real-time thermodynamic modeling, per-core flux simulation, an embedded REST/WebSocket API, a dynamic numeric tray badge, and a Stream Deck companion with zero UAC prompts.
en-US.name: inFaux
